title: Typography
description: The 1.0 type scale (text-tag 10 … text-hero 36, text-ui 12 the base UI size, font-display for hero and big titles) and Prose, which styles long-form text — headings, paragraphs, lists, links, quotes, inline code — from that scale.
when: Help articles, release notes, policies, long AI answers (wrap Markdown in Prose).

instead.need: UI text in cards and forms
instead.use: the type classes directly (text-ui for labels, rows and meta; text-copy for reading copy)

a11y: Keep a real heading order (h2 → h3); Prose caps the line length (max-w-prose) for reading.
